name: Blade Shot
doc: Blade Shot (Mesmerize's enemy attack): a blade thrown from the caster's hand at its target and back, its after-images, the impact's sprites, rings, wings, sparks, glints and streaks. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag012_blade_shot.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Blade
parts.doc: The blade thrown at the target and back to the caster's hand, its after-images, its sounds

parts.title: Impact
parts.doc: Sparks, glints and streaks thrown out of the impact

groups.label: Sparks
groups.doc: Two a tick for Ticks from the impact: life Life, scale Scale + rand

groups.label: Glints and streaks
groups.doc: Five each at the impact: life Life, scale Scale, turned by Spread + rand between them

params.label: Throw sound
params.doc: Played at the caster's hand at its tick

params.label: Catch sound
params.doc: Played when the caster catches the blade

params.label: Tilt
params.doc: Flying out, its tilt a tick (4096: a turn)

params.label: Spin
params.doc: Flying back, its spin a tick

params.label: Catch height
params.doc: The catch sprite this above the blade

params.label: After-images until
params.doc: Two after-images a tick until this tick

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 15 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Streak
params.doc: The sprite sequence streak (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Glint
params.doc: The sprite sequence glint (a flipbook of 13 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Hit
params.doc: The sprite sequence hit (a flipbook of 5 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Flash
params.doc: The sprite sequence flash (a flipbook of 5 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Blade model
params.doc: The prim model blade (a mesh of 144 vertices, 40 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Ring model
params.doc: The prim model ring (a mesh of 69 vertices, 44 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Trail model
params.doc: The prim model trail (a mesh of 110 vertices, 40 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Wing a model
params.doc: The prim model wing a (a mesh of 49 vertices, 48 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Wing b model
params.doc: The prim model wing b (a mesh of 49 vertices, 48 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
